_doc: V2_HUD_Active LIGHT regions JSON (dispatch 5.28 finale). Mockup-anchored rects (qw-screens.jsx ScreenHUD 1041-1346), tightened to element bounds, cross-checked vs the v2_hud_active_light_* baselines at 1440x900. HUD-region-only verdict: gating_regions_only=true makes global metrics informational (BG-confounded over the live arena); the 4 bg_* regions are gating:false; only the 11 HUD-element regions gate. Per-region ssim_threshold calibrated to the measured fixed-viewpoint floor across the 2 LIGHT configs (amber/cyan) at measured-min x ~0.95 (V1 dispatch 5.18 Eser-ratified per-region variance Option B), floored at the 0.20 absolute floor. LIGHT floors differ from DARK per region (palette inversion shifts the cross-renderer floor). Regions clearing the 0.45 region default carry NO override (top_scoreboard_bar, scoreboard_overlay). ammo_readout + crosshair measure below the 0.20 floor (real fidelity gaps, deltaE-confirmed) and are FLAGGED — NOT rubber-stamped: retain the 0.45 default and FAIL pending a follow-up fix dispatch. deltaE2000 left at the region default 35 (V1 pattern). Calibration applied with --allow-threshold-up (downward calibration trips vcompare's threshold-up guard; authorized by the dispatch's explicit V1-5.18-ratified downward-calibration instruction; within measured-floor+buffer, no rubber-stamp). threshold_pct/fuzz_pct/global_threshold_pct are legacy vdiff fields ignored by vcompare.

regions.name: top_scoreboard_bar
regions.rationale: leader|timer|runner-up grid, top:18, centered 480..960. Measured light-min 0.607 — clears the 0.45 region default; NO override (gates at 0.45).

regions.name: top_right_telemetry
regions.rationale: FPS/MS pair, top:18, right:24. Measured light-min 0.238; calibrated 0.22 (=0.238*0.95). Small mono-digit region; cross-renderer rasterization floor.

regions.name: kill_feed
regions.rationale: feed messages, top:80, left:24, maxWidth:380. Measured light-min 0.351; calibrated 0.33 (=0.351*0.95). DYNAMIC-CONTENT: sparse single-player feed — gates panel renders correctly when sparse, not full-feed parity (deltaE confirms colour).

regions.name: health_panel
regions.rationale: HEALTH bottom-left, left:28, bottom:36. Measured light-min 0.281; calibrated 0.26 (=0.281*0.95). clip-path notch corner absent (plain rect).

regions.name: armor_panel
regions.rationale: ARMOR bottom-right mirror, right:28, bottom:36. Measured light-min 0.268; calibrated 0.25 (=0.268*0.95). armor stat 0 at spawn; clip-path mirror corner absent.

regions.name: holdables_strip
regions.rationale: holdables right:28, bottom:144. Measured light-min 0.326; calibrated 0.31 (=0.326*0.95). Player owns 0 holdables at spawn (empty render). Light floor below dark (0.36) — palette inversion.

regions.name: weapon_carousel
regions.rationale: bottom-center, 564 wide centered 438..1002. Measured light-min 0.242; calibrated 0.23 (=0.242*0.95). 9-weapon icon detail; placeholder-overlap artifact resolved by tight rect.

regions.name: ammo_readout
regions.rationale: FLAGGED REAL FIDELITY GAP — NOT calibrated, gates at the 0.45 default and FAILS. The rect is correctly mockup-anchored, but the engine renders its ammo '88' ~75px lower / ~30px right / ~2x taller than the mockup position — a real hudElement LAYOUT divergence no rect can reconcile. Measured light-min 0.116 << 0.20 absolute floor (SSIM-only FAIL; deltaE ~30.5 elevated vs ~7.7 well-matched, corroborating, but PASSES its 35 threshold). Fix is engine/widget work (out of 5.28 scope) -> follow-up fix dispatch.

regions.name: scoreboard_overlay
regions.rationale: TAB-hold board, top:140, centered 270..1170. Measured light-min 0.474 — clears the 0.45 region default; NO override (gates at 0.45). DYNAMIC-CONTENT resolved by rect tightening (gates board chrome).

regions.name: crosshair
regions.rationale: EXTRACTED to the procedural-crosshair-system subsystem (dispatch 6.0 S0). The static-PNG crosshair (which renders 0px here — a crosshair-content-PNG-specific issue, see chain 5.31) is being replaced by a PROCEDURAL solid-color quad/ring reticle with its own future gate. gating:false = extraction to a separate subsystem, NOT a rubber-stamp — the V2 HUD-layout gate now evaluates the non-crosshair regions only.

regions.name: weapon_placeholder
regions.rationale: weapon model placeholder, right:120, bottom:60, LEFT clipped to 1002 (carousel on top). Measured light-min 0.278; calibrated 0.26 (=0.278*0.95). Light floor below dark (0.28) — palette inversion.
